# data-contract

> Validate tabular datasets against a JSON data contract: schema, types, ranges, uniqueness, SQL-style row rules and a freshness SLA with an injected clock. Python package `trysac-data-contract`, import name `data_contract`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Contract format](docs/CONTRACT_FORMAT.md): columns, row rules, freshness
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
